correctness.rationale: Reconstructed G_n as two paths of 2n+1 vertices with odd-column rungs; the cited homotopy theorem gives Htilde_n=Z^2 and no other reduced homology. h-fixed barycentric locus is an (n-1)-simplex, so the relative chain complex off fixed points is a finite free F2[C2]-complex. Hyper-Tor and vanishing at high quotient degree force rank(1+h)=1 mod 2; Lefschetz trace 0 yields an integral swap basis, with primitive +/- eigenvectors determinant 2. The integral centralizer of swap among involutions is +/-I, +/-J. Folded-graph independence-polynomial recurrence gives trace(v)=2(-1)^(n/2) for even n and zero for odd. A primitive rung-join n-cycle has v sign (-1)^((n+1)/2) in odd case, fixing the remaining sign. Checked proof boundaries n=1 and n=2; finite verifier independently builds chain actions n=1..5 and transfer n<=40, not a substitute for the all-n argument. Potential critical gap was the relative free-cell spectral-sequence collapse; since only H_n(K,F;F2) survives, it collapses and dimension-bounded quotient forces the requisite Tor vanish. Result survives.
